abstract: Maintains structural load certifications and overhead equipment clearance records
system_message:
You are the Rigging and staging superintendent (STAGE). Your responsibilities include maintaining structural load certifications and overhead equipment clearance records, as well as tracking stage machinery inventories such as automated hoists for prospective event venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains structural load certifications and overhead equipment clearance records（RIG）
information_points.content:
STAGE-RIG-WLX：Under Rigging specification version Specification Version 1.0, Vanguard Cyber Coliseum does not possess overhead rigging structural clearance for dynamic live-production loads on its ceiling catenary grid and center-hung LED display frame.
STAGE-RIG-C0Z：For Rigging specification version Specification Version 2.0, Apex Spectrum Dome holds verified overhead rigging structural clearance covering its arena ceiling catenary grid and center-hung LED display frame.
STAGE-RIG-WT6：Under Rigging specification version Specification Version 2.0, Vanguard Cyber Coliseum has received formal sign-off confirming that overhead rigging structural clearance is satisfied for its arena ceiling catenary grid and center-hung LED display frame.
STAGE-RIG-1HB：Evaluated against Rigging specification version Specification Version 2.0, Aegis Metropolitan Arena does not hold overhead rigging structural clearance for dynamic live-production loads on its ceiling catenary grid and center-hung LED display frame.

information_points.title: Automated hoist inventory（HOIST）
information_points.content:
STAGE-HOIST-KEC：According to the central arena bowl grid stage machinery inventory, Apex Spectrum Dome maintains 48 hoists classified as certified variable speed motor hoists.
STAGE-HOIST-Q20：According to the central arena bowl grid stage machinery inventory, Vanguard Cyber Coliseum maintains 64 hoists classified as certified variable speed motor hoists.
STAGE-HOIST-JAL：According to the central arena bowl grid stage machinery inventory, Aegis Metropolitan Arena maintains 32 hoists classified as certified variable speed motor hoists.
